history.summary: A large 1,894sqft 4BR in D05 (One-North/Clementi RCR) priced at $1,510 PSF, right on the $1,504 URA median, with a strong 6.42% resale CAGR over 84 transactions. Honest, well-supported value but the $2.86M ticket and oversized family layout sit outside the deep buyer band.
history.rating_rationale: Appreciation is genuine and reliable (6.42%/yr, 84 resale txns, no new-launch bias) and PSF is exactly market (1510 vs 1504 median). However the 1,894sqft size makes the per-PSF look cheaper than it is — the $2.86M absolute price puts it above the $1.8-2.5M liquid sweet spot, narrowing exit to family buyers only. 99LH from 2008 (~81yr remaining) is fine. Yield on a large old-ish leasehold 4BR is modest. Solid hold, not a standout buy.
red_flags: $2.86M ticket above the deepest buyer band; 4BR family-only exit pool
No MRT info captured — D05 accessibility varies by exact location
Oversized unit makes PSF look cheaper than the absolute price implies
catalysts: One-North tech-hub employment demand in D05
TEL connectivity in the broader Clementi/West Coast corridor
Strong demonstrated resale appreciation track record (6.42%/yr)
